constraints.ocl:
context CourseOffering
inv: self.enrollments->any(x | x.enrolledAt <> '') <> null

context Course
inv: self.credits >= 40 and self.credits <= 49

context CourseOffering
inv: self.capacity >= 67 and self.capacity <= 96

context Scholarship
inv: self.startYear <> null implies self.endYear <> null

context Semester
inv: self.startDate <> null implies self.endDate <> null
